text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What?! You're leaving the team?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Only temporarily, mind you. I've some
urgent family matters to attend
to.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! With you gone, who am I gonna
mess with for fun?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How about you don't mess with anybody
for once?!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: It'll feel lonely with you gone...

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah... You're our ace...

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text: McQueen, come back soon, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'm not done running yet.
I'll be
back before you know it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have come to know this team as a place
where we look out for one
another, where
we are free to race toward our dreams.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please, treasure the bonds that we've
forged.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And Rice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I hope to see you pursue your own dream...
of becoming a runner
people will be glad
to see win.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sob. McQueeeeen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a heartfelt farewell, McQueen steps
away from the team for a
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few months later, Rice Shower begins to
struggle once again.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In front is Biwa Hayahide! And Biwa
Hayahide is first across the finish
line! The
bane of McQueen, Rice Shower, comes in
fifth!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: It's just loss after loss for Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
After standing in the way of Bourbon and
McQueen's records, too.
Like, c'mon, try a
little harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's one question on everybody's
mind—where did that Rice
Shower go?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Your performance on the final stretch
isn't
bad. How does it feel?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Your performance on the final stretch
isn't
bad. How does it feel?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can catch up to the lead,
and I
know I'm not running out of
stamina, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, the cause of her losing
streak still eludes me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning the spring Tenno Sho gave her a
boost of confidence and
optimism.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But her results in every race since
haven't
showed that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's still the booing getting to
her,
even if she doesn't realize
it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'll keep running.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I told myself that no matter how much I
lose, or how many people boo
me, I'll still
stand tall.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Besides, I need to become someone fans want to win. I promised McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm going for another lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But there's no end in sight for her slump.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And next we have Rice Shower, who's
been on a losing streak. Will
she return to
form in this race?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: She's just gonna lose again.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, she tries hard, you gotta give her
that.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Fair.
Takes a lot to not give up after losing
so much...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower finishes in sixth!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Where is the Rice Shower who once stood
in Mihono Bourbon and
Mejiro McQueen's
way?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Heheh... Couldn't win today either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She forces a smile, but she's already
welling up...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...No, I won't cry. If I'm going to cry,
I want
it to be tears of joy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All right, back to training! C'mon,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she runs off, her steps seem incredibly
light for one who just
suffered a heavy
loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What can I do to make sure her next tears
are tears of joy?
